name: WeChat Studio
manifestDescription: WeChat MP packages: draft → quality gates → typography → export
title: WeChat Studio
subtitle: Packages · Draft · Quality · WeChat layout · Export
chromeOpenTip: Open WeChat studio · packages / draft / quality / layout
howToOpen: When enabled, open from the AI workspace Apps pane, StatusBar 「WeChat」 chip, or command palette. Toggling off removes those entries. Not a PrimaryNav item.
empty: No packages yet. Use “New package” above to start.
newPackageHint: Creates YYYY-MM-DD-name/ draft.md skeleton under the package root.
editHint: Markdown editor; save goes through workspace writeback with a path receipt.

facts.numbers: Load-bearing numbers verified to primary sources
facts.human: Report-tone symptoms reviewed by hand (perfect score ≠ human)

polishApplied: Polish applied (unsaved). Verify numbers, then save.

settings.title: WeChat Studio
settings.desc: Optional mini-app. Packages → draft → quality → layout → export. Packages default to the creation-category WeChat folder; writes go through workspace writeback.
settings.enabledDesc: When on: Apps pane and StatusBar show 「WeChat」; ⌘K finds WeChat Studio. Toggling off removes those entries.
settings.themeDesc: Default layout-preview theme; switchable in the app
settings.packageRootDesc: Workspace-relative path; empty = creation category / current-year-WeChat

missingDraft: Package “{{name}}” has no draft file and cannot be opened
emptyHint: Package root {{path}}. Create one, or check packageRoot in settings.
exportGateHint: Export is allowed before the gate; prefer AI score ≥85 and facts checked before finalize.
finalizeConfirmDesc: Writes status: Final and renames the folder to …-released. Confirm numbers are verified.

lintRules.itemLong: List item long ({{n}} chars); split or convert to paragraph
lintRules.multipleH1: {{n}} H1 headings in body; keep one title in the MP editor
lintRules.boldPunchline: {{n}} bold punchline endings; soften to plain statements
lintRules.remoteImage: Remote image {{src}} — paste may drop it; export with upload checklist
lintRules.localImage: Local image {{src}} — embed or upload to MP media
lintRules.latex: LaTeX-like formula detected; WeChat needs images

complianceWarn: Script compliance self-check reported warnings; inspect the HTML
checklistEmpty: Generated on export. Local images are embedded when possible; upload missing ones by this list.
